Kind tint rides in the vertex colour (lone / scenery) or a uniform (per-kind material).
* Glass and ice = rock_clear.gdshader (25 lines, SPECULAR 0.7, no texture, world space). Quartz and diamond currently go through the OPAQUE rock.gdshader (no `alpha` in KINDS). Obsidian is opaque too and has a T2 texture (obsidian-fresh only).
